same_sha_reruns.conclusion: Windows picker cancellation, snapshots, and Obsidian reopen passed

platform_findings.ubuntu: The focused Zenity Ctrl+L field showed the fixture path and the confirmation click landed on the visible OK button. OpenObsidian then reported private per-vault storage preparation failed during canonicalize selected vault with ENOENT. Clear the location entry before typing to prevent any residual text from altering the selected path.
platform_findings.macos: The complete native folder selection, cancellation, vault/app-data snapshot, and Obsidian reopen flow passed. eframe app.ron appeared while the native picker opened; its captured contents contained window and egui UI state without vault or app-data paths, then remained unchanged through cancellation and close.
platform_findings.windows: The initial fixture selection succeeded, but the cancellation picker did not appear while UI Automation reported Open vault disabled. The exact-SHA Windows rerun passed picker cancellation, vault/app-data snapshots, and Obsidian reopen.

parallel_groups: Native parallel setup groups passed in all applicable workflows and round-trip jobs.
correction: Reset the focused Linux Ctrl+L location entry with Ctrl+A and Backspace before typing the fixture path. Keep Windows unchanged after the passing same-SHA rerun.
execution_policy: No local tests, builds, formatters, linters, application launches, or executable validation were run. Validation evidence came from GitHub Actions.
